class.name: VideoStreamWebm
class.description: [VideoStream] resource handling the [url=https://www.webmproject.org/]WebM[/url] video format with [code].webm[/code] extension. The WebM codecs are currently decoded on the CPU, although they may be hardware-accelerated in the future. The supported video codecs are VP8 and VP9, and the supported audio codecs are Opus and Vorbis. The VP8 and VP9 codecs are more efficient than [VideoStreamTheora], but they require more CPU resources to decode (especially VP9). [b]Note:[/b] The AV1 and AV2 video codecs are not supported. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [VideoStreamTheora], an alpha channel (also known as transparency) is supported. This means WebM videos may contain transparent areas.
